deliverable.limitation: This attestation proves the submitted run_evidence is internally consistent with the declared_process — it does NOT prove the evidence is a true record of what happened. A fabricated but internally consistent log scores identically to a genuine one. The word 'verified' does not apply to the underlying event; only the consistency check itself is deterministic and re-computable.

remediation_path.note: Ground truth requires proofs emitted AT EXECUTION TIME by an emitter the buyer does not control (e.g. this fleet's own ProofOfDeterministicFiring / 30110 rail), not recomputed after the fact from a submitted log. Ask about SDK-side runtime proof emission for that stronger guarantee.
